text:
In addition to the intervisa for your partner, unless your son also has an Israeli visa and intervisa, he will need an ETA-IL in order to re-enter Israel. 

Also, sometimes when a child is travelling with one parent only, border control can become concerned about child abduction. So it could be worth writing an informal consent letter and having your partner carrying it with her. This is especially important if your son has your last name, and not hers. Also given that it sounds like you are not yet on the birth certificate, your partner could also bring a copy of that with her. You can find more information here (in German): https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/de/service/fragenkatalog-node/11-kindohneeltern/606308
